sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: New ⚠️ WARNING "Several Discogs links in Relationships": a Relationships column cell showing two or more different Discogs URLs (a link and the same link with "?…" count once) is tinted with a ⚠️ and listed in the ⚠️ WARNING menu, where one click filters every table to those rows. It is known once the column has loaded, so the count grows while it loads. Two new settings in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS turn the finding and its tint on or off.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The 📊 list of the Relationships column has a new "Relationship icons - Site kind" section: one entry for a site whatever its country or subdomain, so amazon.com, amazon.de and amazon.co.uk are counted together as "amazon.*". It appears when some site has two or more such hosts; the per-host entries stay.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The link columns of the Credits/Relationships tables, the event page's tables and the sidebar tables — "URL" (URLs), "Target" (Via release group, Via series) and "Link" (Sidebar: …) — have two new 📊 sections: "Links info - Site", one entry per site with the number of rows linking to it and the same site icon the link shows, and "Links info - Site kind", which counts a site whatever its country or subdomain ("amazon.*", "bandcamp.*") when some site has two or more such hosts. Ticking a site marks its address in the link text.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The "YouTube Music Lookup" button of the "MBz YouTube Music Lookup" userscript (by @afro) is now removed after the release page's Credits button too, not only after Tracks.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Event page: a link in the "URLs" table now shows the site icon the sidebar shows for it, as on the other relationship tables — a review link, for example, had its icon only in the sidebar.
